name: KromiumBrowserConfig
declaration: @ConsistentCopyVisibility data class KromiumBrowserConfig internal constructor(val cachePath: String?, val isHeadless: Boolean, val remoteDebuggingPort: Int, val commandLineArgs: List<String>, val customSchemes: List<KromiumCustomScheme>, val schemeRegistrations: List<KromiumSchemeRegistration> = emptyList(), val proxy: KromiumProxy? = null)
description: General browser behavior and storage configuration for the Kromium engine. Controls disk cache directories, headless rendering mode, remote CDP debugging port, command-line arguments, custom URL scheme definitions, and default proxy rules.
whenToUse: Configure within KromiumConfig.builder().browserConfig { ... } to define engine-wide caching, debugging ports, and startup flags.

properties.name: cachePath
properties.description: Filesystem path where persistent cache and storage are kept, or null for in-memory incognito cache.

properties.name: isHeadless
properties.description: Whether the engine operates in headless mode without desktop window handles.

properties.name: remoteDebuggingPort
properties.description: Port for Chromium Remote Debugging Protocol (0 disables remote debugging).

properties.name: commandLineArgs
properties.description: Additional native Chromium command-line switches passed during process initialization.

properties.name: customSchemes
properties.description: Custom URL schemes (e.g. app, res) registered with Chromium prior to engine startup.

properties.name: schemeRegistrations
properties.description: Initial custom scheme handler registrations binding asset handlers to scheme and domain names.

properties.name: proxy
properties.description: Default proxy strategy applied to the engine and all client sessions.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumBrowserConfig.
